findings.claim: The new test file ends with an extra blank line (`}\n\n`; line 49 is empty). gofmt always ends a file with exactly one newline, so `gofmt -l .` lists this file. CI runs that check in engine/ and fails the job when it lists anything (.github/workflows/ci.yml:88-90, `test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" || { gofmt -l .; exit 1; }`). So this commit turns the Gofmt step red. gofmt was not run in this review; this follows from gofmt's fixed output format.

findings.claim: Before this change, closure-feedback found the merge commit itself after the merge and wrote `landing_commit` ("Once the merge has happened, record ... the actual merge commit"). Now it only writes the anchor "from the explicitly recorded landing identity", and SKILL.md requires "an explicitly recorded `landing_commit` before t1". No current actor records that identity. agents/delivery.md runs before the merge and only appends a Log entry naming the reviewed head, and the reference forbids searching history. Failure mode: for every new ODD change, t1 and `total_wall_clock_hours` are always omitted and disclosed as absent, so wall-clock measurement quietly stops. S3/S4 ask for an explicitly recorded landing commit, but the spec names no actor that records it.
